_comment: Explicit name overrides. Key = any raw/variant spelling (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed) OR the algorithm's canonical output. Value = canonical 'Given Family' display name. Add entries here when the parser in canon.mjs gets a name wrong (accents DataRide drops, nobiliary particles, Mc/Mac casing, apostrophe casing, spelling changes across seasons, nicknames). Grown during ingestion as mismatches surface.
_apostrophe_note: DataRide stores some apostrophe surnames with a space (O'Callaghan → 'O CALLAGHAN'). Sweep for these during ingestion and add per name.
